_comment: Translates the references used in source files into the IDs the target system uses. The values below are neutral examples: replace targetId with the IDs configured in your target (Spotlight / DBXDB).
_codeMapsComment: codeMaps holds named lookup tables used by later build steps, e.g. "txnCodeToAction": { "OAT": "TRANSFER_BETWEEN_OWN_ACCOUNT_CREATE" }.

txnTypeToAction._comment: Your transaction codes -> target action IDs. An unmapped code is reported, never guessed.

_approvalActionsComment: Per service definition: the actions a '*' source rule expands to (A-05). Take them from the bank's configuration; the Survey shows how many the target flags (featureaction.isApprovalAction).

approvalSettings._comment: How source approval rules are read. openUpperFrom: your system's 'no upper limit' value; userModeThreshold: the 80/20 rule.
